corrected_answer: Assume one request, dense retention of the stated K/V heads for every layer and token, and nominal 1 byte(s) per INT8 value. Both K and V are stored, so the logical payload is 2 (K,V) x 48 layers x 2048 tokens x 6 KV heads x 64 dimensions x 1 bytes/value = 75,497,472 bytes = 0.070312 GiB (1 GiB = 2^30 bytes). This is an estimate of logical payload, not a runtime-allocation guarantee: verify the deployed dtype and whether quantization scales/zero-points, packing, padding, paging, retention/eviction, prefix sharing, or batching change storage. Weights, activations, workspaces, allocator fragmentation, and other requests are excluded.
